# Moto Care instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` before making changes. For a contributor PR, also read the matching guide in `docs/branches/`.

Never commit directly to `main`, `cam-thu`, or `thanh-vy`; create a task branch and open a PR. Keep changes narrow, do not commit secrets or generated build output, and keep Flutter formatting, analysis, tests, and Android builds passing.
